formal_interface.finite_lemma: Given a field, finite divisor-closed B containing 1, complete monic border relations, correct commuting multiplication columns, source-ideal witnesses and generator annihilation, construct the quotient isomorphism R/I ~= K^B. Compose with the Boolean idempotent lemma for rational point/dimension equality. Unit ideal has its own 1-in-I certificate.
formal_interface.interface: A future proof kernel consumes canonical polynomial dictionaries/exponent vectors, complete border data, witness DAG and exact matrices; trusted finite-field arithmetic and parsing are identified separately from the mathematical theorem. Proof names and theorem statements must match the frozen definitions; no sorry/axiom shortcut or unchecked computational oracle.
formal_interface.why_no_Lean_dispatch: No pinned Lean/mathlib toolchain, verified sparse-polynomial/witness-DAG semantics, or audited library bridge from these serialized border matrices to a polynomial quotient has been established in the read inputs. Machine-checked proof is therefore not claimed or scheduled under an invented ID.
formal_interface.revisit: After independent protocol review accepts the finite lemma and the independent checker/QA snapshot fixes actual data types and hashes, parent may mint a dedicated formal task and snapshot with pinned toolchain and exact theorem. If protocol review requires formal proof before implementation/launch, that requirement becomes an added prerequisite and no implementation starts until resolved.
